Name: Simply Sebastian - A Dialogue Expansion Mod
Author: mattymattloaf
Description:
[center][img]https://i.imgur.com/lOppnXN.png[/img][/center]

[center][size=3]I've revamped my old Sebastian mod (my Sexy Sebby mod) to make it a little fun, flirty, moody, and spicy. There's definitely less spice than the old mod, but I might write spicier ones in the future!

There's around four hundred lines of new festival, gift, pre-marriage, and marriage dialogue. I don't have any custom events since I'm not a coder, and the vanilla events have just been gone through to correct some of the grammar.﻿ I wish I could offer more!

[/size][size=2][color=#9fc5e8]If you're interested in potentially collaborating with me as a coder, feel free to send me a message![/color][/size][url=https://ko-fi.com/mattymattloaf]

[/url][color=#b6d7a8]The main banner art is by me. The secondary banner in the media files has art by my friend, who you can commission [url=https://www.fiverr.com/dietpoison]here![/url]﻿[/color][color=#ea9999]﻿[/color][/center]
